mapper.sql: g.id, g.project_id, p.name AS project_name, g.task_id, t.title AS task_title, g.review_snapshot_id, g.review_decision_id, g.ticket, g.commit_message, g.branch_name, g.commit_sha, g.status, g.failure_reason, COALESCE(u.display_name, u.username, '未知用户') AS operator_name, g.started_at, g.finished_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM git_commit_record g JOIN project p ON p.id = g.project_id JOIN task t ON t.id = g.task_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.operator_id
ORDER BY g.started_at DESC, g.id DESC LIMIT #{filter.size} OFFSET #{offset}
